description: 95 COUNTIES IN 95 HOURSALL95 Day two kicked off with Robert departing Cookeville in the morning. Today's (May 14th) total count came to 21 counties visited by 9:30 pm (eastern time). That brings his total count to 41 counties. In each county, Robert has left behind a painted Peace dollar (coin) in a marked envelope for anyone to find.
